name: Kirisawa Iori
source:
A third-year student. Unlike Kyou, she's a popular student with an overall positive reputation.

Almost all students, both male and female, have some sort of crush on her; she could be described as an ideal schoolgirl.

She's both beautiful and talented, with a polite and gentle demeanor, and has absolutely no traits that would offend other people. As a result, her perfect image almost appears artificial.

She seems to harbor unspoken feelings for Naoya...

[Translated from [url=https://www.light.gr.jp/light/products/imilover/iori/top/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
